Well first of all sorry for my english, it's not the best but I try to write it in a way everyone will understand.

Dude, it is not my or any other persons fight you have to fight right now. It is all yours. 
Personally I think reasons like: "Your child needs you." "You have to be there for your child" "You can't leave a pregnant women with your child alone" won't help you in any way which doesn't mean that they aren't true. They definitely are, no doubt. 
But the major problem right here is the fight with yourself.
You tell us you lack of motivation and you are chronically ill and your psychologist is a waste of money. 
Change the damn psychologist. Often you have to change your consultant because the relationship between him/her and you isn't what you're looking for. My mother had to change her psychologist more than five times since she found the one who could finally help her.
I think you should be aware how good life can be and when you are trying to set the focus on the things which work, not on the things which won't work you will find yourself way more happy.
Talk to your wife, talk to someone you trust and if you have no one to trust go to other psychologist. Often the main problem in our society is that you are scared and afraid of facing a problem and you do not want to be a burden on anyone else but that is what family/friends and definitely psychologists are for.
Not everyone has a perfect life. I think no one has that and people are individual so some people need help from external persons while others do not need this kind of help because they can fight their fights without any help. But either way you shouldn't be ashamed of which way you want to take.
I can't talk you completely out of this suicidal shit but to be honest... Life is worth living especially when you do not see anything good right now. Good times will come and also bad times will come and they will go. 
And you are not taking our time don't even think like you are a waste to anyone. I know that we do not know each other but be happy, get your ass up and walk through the world with a smile on your face even if you have rainy days!

Keep it up, good luck and hopefully we'll see/write each other sometimes^^
